description: This file defines a class 'RemotePortTunnel' which manages SSH port forwarding tunnels for remote mode, including creation, cleanup, port checking, and configuration. It handles process management, port allocation, and logging related to remote port forwarding over SSH.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A class that manages SSH-based remote port forwarding tunnels, including creation, termination, port management, and cleanup.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts a new SSH port forwarding tunnel with specified remote port settings.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH tunnel process and performs cleanup.
